Third-party component: Shizuku
==============================

  Upstream: https://github.com/RikkaApps/Shizuku
  License : Apache License 2.0 — see LICENSE.txt in this directory

How this app uses it
--------------------
QRTR and SE HAL readers reach the SIM card through a process the `shell` user
owns. Shizuku is what runs that process on a phone without root. Without it
both reader types have nothing to talk to.

No Shizuku binary is bundled in this APK
----------------------------------------
This build carries no copy of Shizuku. When the user taps install, the app

  1. asks GitHub for the newest Shizuku release APK URL
     (`api.github.com/repos/RikkaApps/Shizuku/releases/latest`), falling back to
     a pinned upstream release URL if that request fails;
  2. downloads that APK into its own cache directory;
  3. hands it to the Android package installer, which shows the normal
     confirmation dialog.

Nothing is downloaded until the user asks, nothing is installed silently, and
the downloaded bytes are not modified in any way.

What is not included
--------------------
  - No private signing material of any kind.
  - No prebuilt privileged helper other than the unmodified upstream APK the
    user chooses to install.
  - No Shizuku source code is compiled into this app; only the public Gradle
    dependency `dev.rikka.shizuku:api` / `:provider` is used, under the same
    license.
